title: Spot the difference: market stall
prompt: Three things changed between the two market stall pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The pink cupcake changed colour from white to pink, the blue car changed colour from green to blue and the banana vanished. Nothing else is different.
